cases.name: caller-owned-capture-effects
cases.expression: (do (declare thread-macro-b) (eval '(defmacro ^:dynamic thread-macro-b [] 1)) (let [events (atom []) f (fn [& xs] (swap! events conj :expanded) (list '+ 40 2))] [(binding [thread-macro-b f] (eval '(thread-macro-b))) @events]))

cases.name: full-form-env-and-explicit-argument
cases.expression: (do (declare thread-macro-c) (eval '(defmacro ^:dynamic thread-macro-c [] 1)) (binding [thread-macro-c (fn [form env x] (list 'quote [(first form) (contains? env 'lexical-control) x]))] (eval '(let [lexical-control 9] (thread-macro-c (+ 1 2))))))

cases.name: existing-function-result-keeps-identity
cases.expression: (do (declare thread-macro-g) (eval '(defmacro ^:dynamic thread-macro-g [] 1)) (let [f (fn [x] x)] (binding [thread-macro-g (fn [& xs] f)] (identical? f (eval '(thread-macro-g))))))

cases.name: existing-var-result-keeps-identity
cases.expression: (do (declare thread-macro-h) (eval '(defmacro ^:dynamic thread-macro-h [] 1)) (def thread-value 42) (let [v (var thread-value)] (binding [thread-macro-h (fn [& xs] v)] (identical? v (eval '(thread-macro-h))))))

cases.name: failed-expansion-retains-effects-and-restores-thread
cases.expression: (do (declare thread-macro-i) (eval '(defmacro ^:dynamic thread-macro-i [] 1)) (let [events (atom [])] [(try (binding [thread-macro-i (fn [& xs] (swap! events conj :before) (throw (ex-info "stop" {})))] (eval '(thread-macro-i))) (catch Throwable e :error)) @events (eval '(thread-macro-i))]))

qualification: Actual pinned Clojure selected macro thread binding, owned captures/effects/form/env/reentry/identity controls. No native pass claim.
